name: CCM Hockey
note: Listed as a sponsor on HC Lokomotiv Yaroslavl's sponsors page (opened 2026-10-03); equipment partner. Majority owned by Altor Equity Partners (Sweden) since late 2024, with Northleaf Capital Partners (Canada) as co-investor; previously Birch Hill Equity Partners. No human-rights findings against the company found (checked 2026-10-03; only its own modern-slavery statements).
